Beech Queen Air listed in the aviationmuseum.eu survey of the Mareeba collection as VH-FDS. That registration belongs to the Royal Flying Doctor Service Drover held by the Queensland Air Museum, so the Mareeba registration is treated as unreliable and left blank pending a CASA register check. It is the only Queen Air in this collection.
